::: {.col-lg-9 .col-sm-12 .prose}
I run the chair of continuous optimization [OPTIM](https://www.epfl.ch/labs/optim/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} at EPFL since July 2020.

My [group](https://www.epfl.ch/labs/optim/optim-chair-of-continuous-optimization/members/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} works on **optimization**, **statistical estimation** and **numerical analysis**.
Much of what we do is related to nonconvex optimization.

For Riemannian optimization in particular, we develop [a toolbox called Manopt](http://www.manopt.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} and I wrote a [book](https://www.nicolasboumal.net/book/index.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

My 2021 [ERC Starting Grant](https://erc.europa.eu/news/erc-2021-starting-grants-results){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} project GEOSYM runs from fall 2022 to 2027.
Our goal is to harness geometry, symmetry and statistics in optimization to tackle nonconvexity.
This is funded by [SERI](https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/sbfi/en/home/research-and-innovation/international-cooperation-r-and-i/eu-framework-programmes-for-research/horizon-europe/transitional-measures.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

As of Jan. 1st, 2022, I am an [associate editor](https://www.springer.com/journal/10107/editors){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} for Mathematical Programming.

The **blog** of my group is [Race to the bottom](https://www.racetothebottom.xyz){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

::: {.section-label}
Research topics:
:::

- Nonconvex optimization (complexity, structure, dynamics, algorithms)
- Convex and nonconvex relaxations
- Optimization on manifolds
- Statistical estimation

::: {.section-label}
Bio sketch:
:::

Nicolas Boumal studies continuous optimization, with a focus on nonconvexity and geometric structure. Much of his work is on the theory of algorithms and applications. On the software side, he develops the [Manopt toolbox](https://www.manopt.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} for optimization on manifolds. He blogs about optimization at [RaceToTheBottom.xyz](https://www.racetothebottom.xyz/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}. He is an associate professor at EPFL and an associate editor for Mathematical Programming.
